title: Stochastic control with signatures via Riccati equations on the tensor algebra
summary: We solve in semi-explicit form a class of non-Markovian stochastic optimal control problems with path-dependent rewards, using path signatures. We reformulate the control problem as the computation of Laplace transforms of signature functionals thanks to the Boué-Dupuis representation. Exploiting recent signature representations of such transforms on tensor algebras, we determine the value process and the optimal control through an infinite-dimensional system of Riccati equations on the extended tensor algebra.
